description_en: Queries scaling plans of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster. This operation can be used only for AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in elastic mode for Cluster Edition
description_zh: 调用DescribeElasticPlan接口查询弹性计划。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
name: DescribeElasticPlan

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan.

The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length.
The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_).

If you do not specify this parameter, the information about all scaling plans for the specified cluster is returned
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称，取值说明：
长度为2~30字符。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
不填写该参数时，返回指定集群下所有弹性计划的详细信息
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html operation to query the resource group name
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html接口查看资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the scaling plan takes effect. Valid values:

true (default)
false
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划是否生效，取值说明：
true（默认值）：生效。
false：不生效
parameters.name: elastic_plan_enable

ElasticNodeNum.description_en:
The number of nodes that are involved in the scaling plan.

If ElasticPlanType is set to worker, a value of 0 or null is returned.
If ElasticPlanType is set to executorcombineworker or executor, a value greater than 0 is returned
ElasticNodeNum.description_zh:
弹性计划节点数。

当ElasticPlanType为worker时，该参数不返回或返回结果为0。

当ElasticPlanType为executorcombineworker或executor时，该参数返回结果为大于0的数字

ElasticPlanType.description_en:
The type of the scaling plan. Valid values:

worker: scales only elastic I/O resources.
executor: scales only computing resources.
executorcombineworker (default): scales both elastic I/O resources and computing resources by proportion
ElasticPlanType.description_zh:
弹性计划资源类型，取值说明：

worker：弹性IO资源单独弹性。
executor：计算资源单独弹性。
executorcombineworker（默认值）：计算，弹性IO资源按默认比例弹性

ElasticPlanWorkerSpec.description_en:
The resource specifications that can be scaled up by the scaling plan. Valid values:

8 Core 64 GB (default)
16 Core 64 GB
32 Core 64 GB
64 Core 128 GB
12 Core 96 GB
24 Core 96 GB
52 Core 86 GB
ElasticPlanWorkerSpec.description_zh:
弹性计划支持扩容的资源规格，取值说明：

8 Core 64 GB（默认规格）

16 Core 64 GB

32 Core 64 GB

64 Core 128 GB

12 Core 96 GB

24 Core 96 GB

52 Core 86 GB

Enable.description_en:
Indicates whether the scaling plan takes effect. Valid values:

true (default)
false
Enable.description_zh:
弹性计划是否生效，取值说明：
true（默认值）：生效。
false：不生效

EndDay.description_en: The end date of the scaling plan. This parameter is returned only if the end date of the scaling plan is set. The date is in the yyyy-MM-dd format
EndDay.description_zh: 弹性计划结束日期，只有设置了弹性计划结束日期才会返回参数值。格式：yyyy-MM-dd

EndTime.description_en: The restoration time of the scaling plan. The interval between the scale-up time and the restoration time cannot be more than 24 hours. The time is in the HH:mm:ss format
EndTime.description_zh: 弹性计划还原时间，与弹性计划扩容时间的间隔不能超过24小时。格式：HH:mm:ss

MonthlyRepeat.description_en: The days of the month when the scaling plan was executed. A value indicates a day of the month. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
MonthlyRepeat.description_zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。表示每个月的几号，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔

PlanName.description_en: The name of the scaling plan

ResourcePoolName.description_en: The name of the resource group

StartDay.description_en: The start date of the scaling plan. This parameter is returned only if the start date of the scaling plan is set. The date is in the yyyy-MM-dd format
StartDay.description_zh: 弹性计划起始日期，只有设置了弹性计划起始日期才会返回参数值。格式：yyyy-MM-dd

StartTime.description_en: The scale-up time of the scaling plan. The time is in the HH:mm:ss format
StartTime.description_zh: 弹性计划扩容时间，格式：HH:mm:ss

WeeklyRepeat.description_en: The days of the week when the scaling plan was executed. Valid values: 0 to 6, which indicate Sunday to Saturday. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
WeeklyRepeat.description_zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。0～6表示周日到周六，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔
